These notes are designed to be comprehensive chapter-by-chapter summaries for the textbook *Statistical Inference*. I include all of the relevant definitions, theorems, and some key examples, capturing the central concepts that a budding statistician (such as myself!) should know from this material. I will also upload some worked problems at a future date.
